title: Neon Crystal Ball Portrait
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on a wooden desk in a dark blue bedroom. Inside the sphere is the luminous head of a young girl with bright blue eyes, neon green and pink energy tendrils flowing from her yellow hair buns, and red triangular patterns on her cheeks.
prompt: A glowing crystal ball resting on a wooden desk in a child's dark blue bedroom at night, inside the transparent sphere is the portrait of a young girl with bright blue eyes and neutral expression, her hair styled in two glowing yellow buns with neon green and pink energy tendrils flowing outward, red triangular patterns painted on her cheeks, soft magical light illuminating the scene, visible wooden nightstand with child's drawing of a tree and crayons nearby, purple curtains, cloudy night sky visible through window, painted in a vibrant digital art style
